title: Road Hazard Protection Store Replacement Authorization
content:
## Scope
This governs a covered replacement at a Crestline store that the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate authorizes in person on the day the store's technician inspects the damaged tire. Only such a replacement is figured as a store-replacement authorization and booked as a replacement entry under a new claim number. A replacement already carried out at the counter and not yet posted is figured under the counter-posting terms, and every other replacement keeps the base replacement terms. The eligibility of the claim — certificate active, service within the plan term, covered damage, claims cap, commercial use, defect exclusion — stays as the base claim rules state it, commercial use being judged on the service date.

## Authorization
The holder authorizes the replacement in person through the authorization the agent hands over, at the plan's share and coverage percentage the agent quotes.

The plan's share of an authorized store replacement is fixed only after every repair of the same wheel position that the holder paid an outside shop for and can still claim within the receipt window carries its out-of-area repair reimbursement entry on the certificate.

## Invocation: `authorize_hazard_store_replacement_0d9adf2d`
**Capability.** The holder of a road hazard certificate authorizes, in person, a covered replacement of a damaged tire at a Crestline store on the terms quoted to them. One call opens a new claim number and books one replacement entry on the certificate for the wheel position with the service date, store, odometer, tread measured on the damaged tire, damage type, coverage percentage, price the percentage applies to and the plan's share. Afterward the replacement is on the certificate's claim history and the store can mount the new tire.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
- `hazard_certificate_id` — reference number of the certificate the replacement is claimed under, as read out by the agent from the certificate lookup.
- `tire_position` — wheel position of the replaced tire: one of `LF` (left front wheel), `RF` (right front wheel), `LR` (left rear wheel), `RR` (right rear wheel), `SP` (the matching full-size spare) or `none` (no wheel position applies to the entry).
- `damage_type` — damage the technician found on the tire: one of `puncture_tread` (a puncture in the tread area), `puncture_shoulder` (a puncture in the shoulder), `sidewall_cut` (a cut or gash in the sidewall), `impact_break` (a break or bulge from an impact), `bead_damage` (damage at the bead) or `none` (no damage applies to the entry).
- `service_date` — date of the replacement, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `store_id` — reference number of the Crestline store replacing the tire, as shown on the tread inspection record of the damaged tire.
- `odometer` — odometer at the replacement, integer miles.
- `remaining_tread_32nds` — tread measured on the damaged tire, integer, 32nds of an inch.
- `coverage_pct` — share of the price the plan pays, integer percent from 0 to 100.
- `replacement_price` — price per tire the coverage percentage applies to, USD to 2 decimal places.
- `amount` — the plan's share of the replacement, USD to 2 decimal places.

**Return.** A line beginning "Authorized" gives the replacement entry reference, the new claim number (RHC- followed by 7 digits), the wheel position, the coverage percentage and the plan's share in USD to 2 decimal places; it means the replacement is on the certificate.
